scripts.generate: npm run generate -w api && netsuite-api generate
scripts.dev: npm run generate && npm run dev -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run generate && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.build: npm run generate && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w api
scripts.update:amerilux: npm install @amerilux/netsuite-api@latest -w api -w client && npm install @amerilux/netsuite-repository@latest @amerilux/netsuite-wrapper@latest -w api
